$comment: files.get -> GET /drive/v3/files/{fileId}, response File. Read from the Drive v3 discovery document 2026-09-30. Deliberately metadata only, never the file's bytes -- webContentLink is a browser download URL a host fetches directly with the same credential, the same 'bytes never pass through the connector' precedent Resend and Microsoft Teams already set for exactly this reason.
title: Google Drive file
description: Read one file's metadata and its download/view links.

config.label: File ID
config.description: From file_list, or another node's output.

outputShape.description: Bytes, as a decimal STRING -- Drive's own int64 convention. Absent for Google Workspace editor files (Docs, Sheets, Slides) and for folders.
Parent folder ids. A file has at most one today even though the field stays an array.
Opens the file in its Drive/editor viewer. Requires the viewer to already have access.
A direct download URL for files with binary content. Absent for Google Workspace editor files and folders -- those export instead, which this connector does not yet offer.
Which estate this ran against. Google has no sandbox, so: fake or live.
